name: Vector space
description: Set closed under addition and scalar multiplication satisfying associativity, commutativity, identity, inverses, and distributivity. Foundation for all substrate representations.

name: Inner product
description: Bilinear form on vector space producing scalar. Conjugate-symmetric, positive-definite. Defines similarity, length, and angle.

name: Cosine similarity
description: Normalized inner product. Measures angular alignment between vectors independently of magnitude. Range [-1, 1].

name: Complex field
description: Field of complex numbers C with addition, multiplication, division. Closed under operations; algebraically closed. Underlies FHRR.

name: Real field
description: Field of real numbers R. Ordered, complete, archimedean. Underlies HRR.

name: Unit modulus constraint
description: Restriction of complex (or real) elements to magnitude = 1. Yields the unit circle in C; phasor representation. Preserves binding-unbinding inverses exactly in FHRR.

name: Probability distribution
description: Non-negative function summing/integrating to 1 over its support. Foundation for inference, weak labels, and confidence.

name: Shannon entropy
description: Expected information content of a distribution. H(p) = -sum p_i log p_i. Measures uncertainty; lower bound on coding length.

name: KL divergence
description: Asymmetric measure of divergence between two distributions. D_KL(p||q) = sum p_i log(p_i/q_i). Non-negative; zero iff p=q.

name: Group axioms
description: Closure, associativity, identity element, inverses. Foundation for binding operations and reversible compositions.

name: Ring axioms
description: Abelian group under addition plus associative multiplication plus distributivity. Underlies polynomial and matrix algebras.

name: Field axioms
description: Ring where every nonzero element has multiplicative inverse. R, C, Q. Foundation for vector spaces.

name: Convex optimization
description: Optimization over convex objective and constraints. Polynomial-time solvable; global optimum guaranteed.

name: Discrete optimization
description: Optimization over discrete/combinatorial spaces. Often NP-hard in general; certain structured cases polynomial (assignment, MST, shortest-path).

name: Graph topology
description: Vertices + edges + adjacency structure. Directed, undirected, weighted, bipartite variants. Foundation for routing, retrieval, and analogy.

name: FHRR binding
description: Element-wise complex multiplication of two unit-modulus phasor vectors. Binding operation in Fourier Holographic Reduced Representation. Inverse is FHRR unbinding.

name: FHRR unbinding
description: Element-wise multiplication by complex conjugate. Inverse of FHRR binding; recovers one operand given binding output and other operand.

name: Cleanup
description: Project a noisy substrate vector onto the nearest atom in a codebook. Implements associative memory recall. Implemented via cosine or Hamming nearest-neighbor.

metadata.complexity: O(N*K) where K is codebook size

name: Bundling
description: Vector sum followed by normalization. Implements superposition; allows multiple substrate items to coexist in one vector.

name: Tier-2 schema (count-weighted superposition)
description: Substrate Tier-2 storage as count-weighted superposition of constituent atoms. Carries count statistics (generative) or learned weights (discriminative). Foundation for count-NB and discriminative-perceptron substrate variants.

name: Context binding
description: Bind context vector with payload to disambiguate polysemic or context-dependent retrieval.

name: Role-filler binding
description: Bind role vectors to filler vectors to encode structured relations. Core of relational substrate representation.

name: Superposition
description: Vector sum without normalization. Pre-bundling operation.

name: Hamming distance
description: Number of differing positions between bipolar vectors. Discrete similarity measure for bipolar substrates.

name: Cosine cleanup
description: Cleanup using cosine similarity to rank codebook atoms.

name: Circular convolution (HRR binding)
description: Binding operation in Holographic Reduced Representation. FHRR (frequency-domain) is the FFT dual.

name: HMM emission probability
description: Probability of observation given hidden state. P(observation | state). Computed via count statistics or substrate Tier-2 schema.

name: HMM transition probability
description: Probability of next state given current state. P(state_{t+1} | state_t). Captures sequential structure.

name: Viterbi decoding
description: Dynamic-programming algorithm for max-probability state sequence given observations. Globally optimal over linear chains.

name: Forward algorithm
description: DP for marginal observation likelihood under HMM. Sum over all state sequences.

name: Backward algorithm
description: DP for backward HMM probabilities. Used in EM and posterior decoding.

name: Count-based Naive Bayes
description: Naive Bayes classifier with count-statistic priors stored as Tier-2 schemas. Validated substrate-only on intent (0.834) and slot-filling.

name: Averaged discriminative perceptron
description: Linear classifier with learned weights via mistake-driven update + averaging. Validated substrate-only on MAWPS 0.806, MultiArith 0.753 (2-op), CODE algorithm-pattern 0.750.

name: Collins structured perceptron
description: Structured-output perceptron with assignment-constraint decoding. Joint weights over structured outputs. Tested 2-quantity SVAMP: indistinguishable from flat perceptron within 2SE; benefit at 3+ entities.

name: Hungarian algorithm
description: Polynomial-time optimal bipartite-matching algorithm minimizing total cost. Globally optimal over assignment polytope.

name: Jonker-Volgenant algorithm
description: More efficient bipartite-matching solver, particularly for sparse cost matrices.

name: Chu-Liu-Edmonds algorithm
description: Directed minimum spanning tree (arborescence) algorithm. Globally optimal tree-structured decoding.

name: Prim's MST algorithm
description: Greedy minimum spanning tree algorithm for undirected weighted graphs.

name: Dijkstra's algorithm
description: Single-source shortest-path algorithm for non-negative-weight graphs.

name: A* search
description: Heuristic-guided shortest-path search. Optimal with admissible heuristic.

name: Beam search
description: K-best approximate search keeping top-K candidates at each step. Trades optimality for tractability.

name: Dynamic programming
description: Optimal substructure + overlapping subproblems via memoization. Foundation for Viterbi, MST, edit-distance, etc.

name: PCA whitening
description: Decorrelate features via PCA followed by variance normalization. Preserves variance structure aligned with principal axes.

name: ZCA whitening
description: Zero-phase whitening; preserves orientation of original axes. Rotation-equivalent to PCA whitening.

name: Bayesian inference
description: Posterior = likelihood * prior / evidence. General framework for substrate-stored posterior updates.

name: MAP estimation
description: Maximum a posteriori; the mode of the posterior. Used in classification and inference.

name: Expectation-maximization
description: Iterative algorithm for parameter estimation with latent variables. E-step computes posteriors; M-step maximizes parameters.

name: Answer-consistency weak labels
description: Weak-supervision method: for each training example, find latent assignment that makes the schema constraint yield the gold answer. Used in substrate MATH solver to train without role annotations.

name: Cross-entropy loss
description: Loss function for probabilistic classification. -log P(true_class).

name: Perceptron weight update
description: Mistake-driven weight update: w += y*x on mistake. Foundation of perceptron and structured-perceptron learning.

name: Global discrete optimization (family)
description: Algorithms providing global optimum over discrete combinatorial spaces in polynomial time via problem structure. Hungarian, MST, Viterbi, Chu-Liu-Edmonds all instantiate this family.

name: Probabilistic inference (family)
description: Methods for computing posteriors, marginals, or modes of probability distributions. Bayesian inference, EM, HMM forward-backward, MAP all instantiate this family.

name: Discriminative classification (family)
description: Methods learning weights to discriminate classes from input features. Perceptron, count-NB, structured perceptron instantiate this family.

name: Representation transform (family)
description: Linear or nonlinear transforms that change vector representation while preserving information. PCA, ZCA, embedding mappings instantiate this family.

name: Graph traversal (family)
description: Algorithms exploring graph structure: shortest-path, heuristic search, BFS/DFS. Dijkstra, A*, beam search instantiate this family.

name: Sequence decoding (family)
description: DP-based optimal-sequence decoders for chain-structured outputs. Viterbi, forward, backward instantiate this family.

name: Weak supervision (family)
description: Methods training models without gold-standard labels using surrogate signals (answer-consistency, distant-supervision, noisy labels).

name: Algebraic binding (family)
description: Substrate operations that compose two vectors into a structured combination with inverse. FHRR binding, HRR circular convolution, role-filler binding instantiate this family.

name: Cleanup retrieval (family)
description: Methods projecting noisy substrate vectors onto codebook atoms via nearest-neighbor in some metric.

name: Superposition aggregation (family)
description: Methods combining multiple substrate items via vector sum (+normalize). Bundling, superposition, Tier-2 weighted bundles.
